subtitle: Lesson 35 · Cosmos DB Querying & Application Integration

code:
SELECT c.name, c.type
FROM c
WHERE c.type = "customer"
ORDER BY c.name

SELECT VALUE c.name FROM c
caption: "c" isn't a table — it's every item in the container.

code:
SELECT c.id, c.address.city
FROM c
WHERE IS_DEFINED(c.address)

SELECT VALUE tag
FROM c
JOIN tag IN c.tags
WHERE c.type = "product"
caption: JOIN here unwinds an array inside one document — not a second table.
